claims.claim: After closing CoolIT, Ecolab says its Global High-Tech business is approaching $1.5B of 2026 annualized sales, is growing more than 25% annually, and targets $4B annual sales by 2030; the platform explicitly spans fabs, power and AI data-center cooling/water systems.

risks.risk: The 2030 $4B target is management aspiration and depends on integration, AI infrastructure spending and successful cross-selling.

unknowns.unknown: Standalone CoolIT revenue, purchase-price return profile and customer concentration are not established by this release.

claims.claim: Ecolab Q2 2026 reported sales rose 10%, organic sales accelerated 5%, Ecolab Digital sales rose 27% to $121M, and adjusted operating income rose 10% as pricing more than offset commodity costs and growth investments.

risks.risk: Acquisition financing increased interest expense and reported results include special gains/charges, requiring normalization by Alpha.
